t.E261.agn: JECFA has noted that acetic acid from vinegar is regularly consumed by humans. In 1973 JECFA set the group ADI for acetic acid and its potassium/sodium salts as 'not limited', and this decision was maintained in 1997.
t.E261.body: Acetate is a compound involved in the body's normal metabolism.
t.E261.eval: The potassium salt of acetic acid (the acid in vinegar); acetate is involved in the body's normal metabolism. In 1973 JECFA set the group ADI for acetic acid and its potassium/sodium salts as 'not limited'; the decision was maintained in 1997.
t.E261.found.0: May be used in many foods in the EU at quantum satis (as much as needed)
t.E261.prod: Acetic acid may be produced by fermentation or chemical synthesis; its salts are obtained by neutralising the acid.
t.E261.regx.1: Group I additive; generally authorised at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E261.summary: The potassium salt of acetic acid. It regulates acidity and is a preservative.
t.E261.what: It is the potassium salt of acetic acid and is used as a preservative and acidity regulator.
